projects.name: Dootify
projects.overview: Dootify is a dynamic task delegation and gig marketplace that empowers users to seamlessly requesting and providing services. Whether someone needs a task done or wants to offer their skills for extra income, Dootify creates a secure and efficient environment to connect people. With intuitive task posting, a built-in coin system, verified user profiles, and a robust review system, Dootify fosters trust, convenience, and financial opportunities within a vibrant community.
projects.description:
**A Versatile Platform for Task Delegation & Gig Work**

Dootify transforms the way people manage tasks by offering a flexible marketplace where users can be both seekers (requesting tasks) and providers (offering services) depending on their needs. Whether it's hiring someone for an errand, finding a skilled professional, or offering one's expertise for extra income, Dootify seamlessly connects users in a secure and efficient manner.

**How It Works**

**1. Post a Task or Browse Opportunities:** Users can either request a task or explore existing tasks they can complete.
**2. Receive & Send Offers:** Those needing help receive proposals from interested providers, while providers can actively bid on available tasks.
**3. Choose the Best Match:** Seekers review provider profiles, ratings, and pricing before making a selection.
**4. Task Completion & Secure Payment:** Once the task is done, seekers confirm completion, and providers get paid.


**Key Features**

🔹 **Dual-Role Flexibility:** Every user can be both a seeker and a provider based on their needs.
🔹 **Task & Service Listings:** Users post or browse tasks and services categorized for easy discovery.
🔹 **Gamified Coin System:** Coins are used for posting tasks, boosting visibility, and earning rewards.
🔹 **Identity Verification & Reviews:** A trust-based environment with user verification and transparent ratings.
🔹 **Category Subscriptions:** Users get instant alerts for new tasks in their chosen categories.
🔹 **Boosted Offers:** Providers can pay for increased visibility, ensuring higher chances of selection.
🔹 **Offline Access:** Users can check their tasks and status even without an internet connection.
🔹 **Targeted Ads & Monetization:** Businesses can promote services directly to the user base.


**Admin & Management Features**

Dootify includes an admin panel for managing:
**User & Task Moderation:** Ensuring security and fair usage.
**Coin Transactions & Subscriptions:** Overseeing purchases and platform monetization.
**Analytics & KPIs:** Tracking platform engagement and optimizing the user experience.


**Empowering Users & Redefining Work**

With its user-friendly interface, secure interactions, and flexible earning potential, Dootify is more than just a gig platform—it's a thriving ecosystem where anyone can get things done and earn income on their own terms. 🚀

projects.name: Ghawth
projects.overview: Ghawth is a non-profit initiative dedicated to connecting communities with families living in extreme hardship. The platform enables volunteers, particularly scouts and campers, to organize and participate in help camps that provide direct assistance—whether physical, material, or social—to families in need. Through a mobile application, users can identify those requiring aid, coordinate assistance efforts, and foster collaborative community engagement to uplift lives.
projects.description:
***Objectives***

**1. Empower Communities:** Provide a structured platform for volunteers, scouts, and community members to contribute effectively to social good.
**2. Assist Families in Need:** Develop a verified and reliable database of families who require various types of assistance.
**3. Streamline Processes:** Utilize technology to enhance the efficiency of planning, verifying, and executing humanitarian efforts.
**4. Promote Transparency:** Ensure accountability by tracking all aid efforts and making them visible to relevant stakeholders.


***Key Features***

**Family in Need Model**
The platform maintains a structured database of families requiring assistance, ensuring their needs are documented and addressed effectively. Key details include:
**Members Count:** Total number of family members.
**Members Details:** Name, age, and gender of each member.
**Address:** The family's physical location.
**Phone Number:** Contact information for communication.
**Coordinates:** GPS location for precise mapping.
**Help Type:** Categories such as construction, food, education, and healthcare.
**Detailed Assistance Required:** A free-text field allowing customization of aid needs.


***User Roles***

**1. Standard User**
**Register Account:** Create an account to access platform features.
**Sign Up for Marsoul Elkhyr:** Get notified to verify new actions and events.
**Add a Family in Need:** Submit information about families requiring help.
**List Families:** Browse all documented cases in need of assistance.
**Request New Help Categories:** Suggest additional types of support.
**Map View:** Visualize the locations of families in need.
**Notify Marsoul Elkhyr:** Alert community representatives for verification of actions.

**2. Admin User**
**Approve New Actions:** Review and validate submitted family cases.
**Manage Users:** Oversee user activity and collaborate with Marsoul Elkhyr.
**Approve New Help Categories:** Expand and manage categories of assistance.
**Notifications:** Receive alerts for pending approvals and requests.


***Perspective: Initiative Planning***
A feature enabling users to create and manage initiatives aimed at helping specific families. Includes:
**Add Initiative:** Link a help campaign to a specific family.
**Attach Users:** Collaborate by adding users to an initiative.
**Group Chat:** Facilitate real-time discussions and planning.
**To-Do List:** Organize tasks to ensure successful execution of aid efforts.


***Application Screens***

**1. Splash Screen**
Displays the Ghawth logo and tagline.
Includes a brief animation or loading progress indicator.
**2. Onboarding Screens**
Introduces Ghawth's mission and core features.
Allows users to skip or proceed to the next step.
**3. Authentication Screens**
    **a. Login**
    Email/phone and password fields.
    "Forgot Password?" and social media login options.
    **b. Sign-Up**
    Collects user information and offers notification subscription.
    **c. Password Recovery**
    Allows password reset via email/phone.
**4. Home Screen**
Displays a list of families in need.
Provides an option to switch to map view.
Features a notification center.
**5. Family Management Screens**
    **a. Add Family**
    Form for inputting family details.
    Address selection with map integration.
    Submission for admin verification.
    **b. Family Details**
    Displays full information about a family.
    Includes a visibility trace log for accountability.
    Option to attach an initiative.
    **c. Family List**
    Searchable and filterable list of families.
    Direct access to detailed family profiles.
    **d. Map View**
    Displays families' locations.
    Filters for viewing by help category.
**6. Initiative Management Screens**
    **a. Create Initiative**
    Select a family, define a help campaign, and invite users.
    Set up a to-do list for task management.
    **b. Initiative Details**
    Provides an overview of the initiative, participating users, and progress tracking.
    Includes a group chat feature for collaboration.
    **c. Initiative List**
    Displays all active and completed initiatives.
**7. User Profile Screens**
Displays user details, including past contributions.
Allows editing of personal information.
**8. Admin Screens**
    **a. Admin Dashboard**
    Provides an overview of pending requests and ongoing initiatives.
    **b. Verify Family Requests**
    Displays unverified family cases for approval or rejection.
    **c. Manage Categories**
    Enables admins to add, edit, or remove help categories.
    **d. Manage Users**
    Admins can view and filter users by roles.
**9. Notifications Screen**
Displays alerts for updates, approvals, and activity tracking.
**10. Chat Screens**
    **a. Group Chat**
    Allows initiative members to communicate in real time.
    **b. Direct Chat**
    Facilitates direct messaging between admins and representatives.
**11. To-Do List Screen**
Displays initiative-specific tasks.
Tracks completion status.
**12. Settings Screen**
Allows users to configure notifications and language preferences.
**13. About Us Screen**
Provides details about Ghawth's mission and contact information.
**14. Offline Mode Screen**
Displays cached data when the user is offline.


***Conclusion***
Ghawth is a transformative initiative leveraging technology to bridge the gap between communities and families in crisis. By fostering collaboration, transparency, and efficient planning, it aims to create a more impactful and structured approach to humanitarian aid.

projects.name: Abid Concept
projects.overview: Driven by a passion for craftsmanship and digital innovation, I developed Abid Concept, a dynamic website that empowers a woodworking business to showcase its unique furniture creations. Designed with a seamless user experience in mind, the platform features an intuitive interface where visitors can browse products, explore promotions, and place orders with ease. In addition to the main website, an admin portal and an Android app were built to streamline product management, order processing, and business analytics, ensuring a comprehensive digital ecosystem for the client.
projects.description:
**A Digital Showcase for Handcrafted Wooden Products**

Abid Concept is a dynamic e-commerce platform designed to help a woodworking business highlight its artisanal furniture collections. The website provides an engaging shopping experience, allowing users to explore products, filter by categories, and place orders effortlessly. With a clean and modern UI, the site ensures both aesthetics and functionality, making it easy for customers to navigate and interact with the brand.


**User-Focused Website Experience**

The main website consists of three core pages:
**Home Page:** A visually appealing entry point featuring a promotional banner, a category filter for quick browsing, a paginated product showcase, user reviews, company values, and a footer with essential business information.
**Products Page:** A comprehensive catalog displaying featured and promotional products, as well as all available items. Customers can search and filter by category to find what they need quickly.
**Contact Us Page:** A simple yet effective form allowing customers to send inquiries directly to the client, fostering communication and customer engagement.

Additional key user-facing functionalities include:
**Shopping Cart:** Users can review and manage selected products before proceeding to checkout.
**Order Screen:** A user-friendly form where customers input details for placing an order online.
**Success Screen & Facebook Pixel Integration:** Once an order is completed, this page ensures smooth conversion tracking, aiding in targeted advertising campaigns.


**Comprehensive Admin & Mobile Management System**

To support the seamless operation of the business, a dedicated admin subdomain and Android app were developed, offering full control over the platform's content and workflow. The admin panel enables the business owner to:
**Manage Products & Categories:** Effortlessly add, edit, and organize products with detailed descriptions and images.
**Oversee Orders & Deliveries:** Track customer orders, assign delivery companies, and ensure efficient logistics.
**Modify Static Content & Translations:** Update business information and product descriptions in multiple languages to reach a broader audience.
**Monitor Business Performance:** A dashboard provides insightful statistics, tracking KPIs for data-driven decision-making.
**Advanced Filtering & Follow-ups:** Useful tracking tools help streamline business operations and enhance customer service.


**A Scalable & Conversion-Driven Platform**

The integration of Facebook Pixel ensures efficient ad campaign tracking, allowing the client to optimize marketing strategies and boost sales. The platform's modular structure enables future scalability, whether by expanding the product catalog, adding new features, or integrating with third-party services.

By crafting a feature-rich website with an intuitive admin system, I successfully delivered a powerful digital storefront that bridges traditional woodworking craftsmanship with modern e-commerce capabilities.

projects.name: Sahti
projects.overview: Developed a health app (Sahti) to address the lack of a centralized healthcare platform in the client's country. Enhanced existing codebase, UI/UX design, and implemented features like an admin dashboard and patient-pharmacist chat.
projects.description:
**Addressing the Need for a Centralized Healthcare Platform**

Sahti is a mobile application designed to bridge the gap in the client's healthcare system by offering a centralized platform for patients, pharmacists, and administrators. This project stemmed from the client's initial efforts and was completed within a one-month timeframe.

**Project Phases and Deliverables**

The project unfolded over five weeks, with each week focusing on a specific aspect of the app:

* **Week 1: Codebase Refinement** - Focused on fixing numerous errors, warnings, and performance bottlenecks within the existing codebase.

* **Week 2: UI/UX Enhancements** - Enhanced the user interface and user experience (UI/UX) across all screens to ensure a smooth and intuitive user flow.

* **Week 3: Admin BI Dashboard Implementation** - Developed a comprehensive admin business intelligence (BI) dashboard for data visualization and informed decision-making.

* **Week 4: Patient-Pharmacist Chat Integration** - Implemented a chat module enabling real-time communication between patients and pharmacists.

* **Week 5: Final Touches & Graduation Support** - Provided coaching to the client regarding graduation report, presentation, and addressed any remaining bugs or enhancements.

**Features and Functionalities**

Sahti caters to three distinct user roles: patients, pharmacists, and admins, each with a tailored set of functionalities:

* **Patients**
    * Search for doctors, nurses, pharmacies, and specific medications.
    * Set medication reminders and doctor appointment notifications.
    * Chat with pharmacies for inquiries or consultations.

* **Pharmacists**
    * Manage pharmacy profiles, including adding available medications.
    * Respond to patient chat messages and inquiries.

* **Admins**
    * Manage nurse and doctor profiles within the platform.
    * Access the BI dashboard for data visualization and insights to make informed decisions regarding the healthcare system.

**Addressing a Critical Need**

By developing Sahti, we aimed to contribute to a more streamlined and patient-centric healthcare experience in the client's country. The app empowers patients with better access to information, communication channels, and medication management tools. Pharmacists benefit from a centralized platform to manage their inventory and interact with patients, while the admin dashboard provides valuable insights for optimizing healthcare delivery.

projects.name: The LandLord
projects.overview: Empowered by our collaborative effort, I, specializing in front-end development, and Mohamed Melek Chtourou, focusing on back-end development, delivered a robust rental property management website for The LandLord. Inspired by the familiar and user-friendly interface of Airbnb, this platform caters to both renters seeking their perfect accommodations and property owners aiming to streamline their rental operations.
projects.description:
**A Comprehensive Solution for Renters and Landlords**

The Landlord website provides a one-stop shop for renters and property owners. Renters benefit from a comprehensive search interface with filtering options for location, property type, and availability. An integrated map aids in visualizing property locations, fostering informed decision-making. Once they find their ideal rental, renters can explore detailed descriptions, captivating photo galleries, and a secure booking process with prepayment functionality and an integrated payment system. To enhance communication and transparency, the platform features a chat module allowing renters to connect directly with property owners.

**Empowering Property Owners**

Landlords can effortlessly list their properties with detailed descriptions, photos, and availability management tools. The platform offers two distinct services: individual rentals for tenants and all-inclusive property management solutions. The latter caters to owners seeking a comprehensive package, encompassing listing management, booking coordination, and potentially additional services tailored to their needs.

**Seamless User Experience and Scalability**

The website prioritizes user experience with an intuitive design inspired by Airbnb. This familiarity minimizes the learning curve for both renters and property owners. The high-performance backend infrastructure ensures efficient data handling and scalability to accommodate future growth. Notably, the platform integrates seamlessly with Rentals, a third-party platform that manages client properties across various rental giants like Airbnb, le bon coin, and Booking.com. This integration eliminates the need for manual updates on multiple platforms and streamlines property management.

**Addressing Diverse User Needs**

The Landlord website caters to three distinct user types: renters seeking their dream accommodations, property owners managing their rentals within the platform, and external partner clients with similar property management needs in other countries. This versatility highlights our ability to design and develop solutions that cater to a diverse range of users within the rental property management domain.

**Key Features**

**Listings & Search:** Landlords effortlessly list properties with detailed descriptions, photos, and availability. Renters enjoy a user-friendly search interface with filters for location, composition, and date.

**Interactive Map:** Visualize property locations with an integrated map, aiding informed decision-making.

**Property Details & Gallery:** Renters explore detailed property descriptions and captivating photo galleries.

**Booking & Payment:** Securely book properties with a streamlined prepayment screen and integrated payment system.

**User Management:** Users create profiles, manage favorites, track booking history, and connect with property owners through a built-in chat module.

**Landlord Services:** The website offers two distinct services: individual rentals for tenants and all-inclusive property management solutions for owners.

**Additional Pages:** Informative About Us and Contact Us sections provide transparency and easy communication channels.

**Third-Party Integration:** Seamlessly integrates with Rentals, a platform managing client properties across various rental platforms like Airbnb, le bon coin, and Booking.com.

**User-Friendly Design:** The website boasts an intuitive and familiar design inspired by Airbnb, simplifying navigation and user experience.

**High-Performance Backend:** The backend infrastructure prioritizes speed and security, ensuring efficient data handling even with partner integrations.

**Scalability:** The platform accommodates three user types: renters, property owners within the Landlord platform, and external partner clients with similar property management needs.

By delivering this feature-rich and user-centric platform, we successfully addressed the needs of The LandLord and showcased our expertise in creating scalable web solutions for the rental property management landscape.

projects.name: My Budget Tracker
projects.overview: Developed a user-friendly budgeting app to empower individuals with financial clarity and informed spending habits.
projects.description:
**Taking Control of Your Finances**

My Budget Tracker is a personal project designed to simplify financial management and promote informed decision-making. This mobile app provides a comprehensive set of features to track income, expenses, and spending patterns, offering valuable insights into your financial health.

**Intuitive Interface and Streamlined Tracking**

The app boasts a user-friendly interface with several key screens:

* **Overview:** Provides a centralized view of all transactions, including a search function for easy filtering. Additionally, a quick summary of your monthly income, expenses, and current balance keeps you informed at a glance.

* **Budgeting:** Empower yourself by creating customized budgets for specific categories. Set spending limits to stay on track and achieve your financial goals.

* **Insights-Driven Analytics:** Enhance your financial awareness with insightful charts and graphs within the Stats section. Visualize your spending habits by category, subcategory, day, and even the nature of your expenses (needs, must-haves, wants). This data empowers you to make informed spending decisions.

* **Comprehensive Toolkit for Financial Management**
My Budget Tracker goes beyond basic tracking by offering a suite of valuable tools:

		 - **Customization:** Personalize the app's theme, currency, and language for a tailored user experience.

		 - **Account & Category Management:** Organize your finances efficiently by managing multiple accounts and expense categories.

		 - **Enhanced Security:**  Protect your data with biometric authentication for secure app access.

		 - **Reminder System:** Stay on top of your finances with customizable reminders for daily transaction entries and monthly bill payments.

		 - **Data Management:** Backup and restore your transaction data seamlessly using Notion integration. Additionally, the app allows you to delete all transactions or manage your user data.

		 - **Recurring Transactions:** Simplify your budgeting by setting up recurring transactions. The app learns from your entries and suggests automated transaction creation for recurring expenses.

**My Budget Tracker** is a valuable companion for anyone seeking to gain control of their finances and make smarter spending choices. By providing a comprehensive overview of your financial situation alongside insightful analytics and a robust toolkit, this app empowers you to achieve your financial goals.

projects.name: Attadabor fi Quran
projects.overview: Elevate your spiritual journey with Attadabor fi Quran, a unique meditation app merging personal reflections, community insights, and dynamic Quranic templates for a profound and personalized experience.
projects.description:
**Introducing Attadabor fi Quran: A Revolutionary Meditation and Reflection App**

Embark on a transformative journey with Attadabor fi Quran, a unique application designed to facilitate meditation and reflection on the profound verses of the Quran. This app goes beyond traditional Quranic applications, offering users a personalized and communal experience.

**Personal Reflections:**
Initiate your spiritual journey solo by adding personal reflections on specific words or verses. Your thoughts become a sacred space for introspection.

**Community Connection:**
Transition from solitude to community as you explore what others around the world are thinking about the same verses. Share your insights and connect with a global community of like-minded individuals.

**Dynamic Vocabulary Integration:**
Every word added to "My Dictionary" becomes a beacon in your Quran reading. Witness the brilliance of your insights as the highlighted words guide your understanding and prompt updates.

**Innovative Templates:**
Unleash your creativity with customizable templates. Whether it's a template highlighting stories of prophets with distinct colors or a comprehensive categorization like the "4 Columns" template, the possibilities are endless. Achieve 100% coverage and organization of the Quran according to your unique perspective.

**Effortless Search:**
Navigate the vast Quran effortlessly by searching for specific words or characters. The app ensures a seamless exploration of the divine text.

**Intuitive Navigation:**
Access any Surah quickly with the user-friendly navigation drawer. Experience fluid movement through the chapters of the Quran.

**Audio Experience:**
Immerse yourself in the beauty of the Quranic recitation. Play and listen to the verses, enhancing your connection with the divine message.

**Data Management:**
Attadabor fi Quran prioritizes user control. All your data is securely saved locally, and the app allows synchronization with your Notion database, providing a seamless experience across platforms.

**Customization Features:**
Tailor your reading experience with customizable options. Adjust font family, font size, Quran presentation (cards, continuous, pages), and enable/disable dark mode. Choose your preferred translator for an enriched understanding, especially in card mode with included English translations.

Attadabor fi Quran is not just an app; it's a companion on your spiritual journey, empowering you to engage with the Quran in a profound and personalized way. Elevate your meditation, reflection, and connection with the divine with this innovative application.

projects.name: Tesa Ranking
projects.overview: Test Ranking is the heartbeat of Tesa association's e-gaming community. A Flutter and NodeJS-powered mobile app centralizing news, tournaments, and player rankings, with upcoming Challonge API integration for seamless tournament management and enhanced user engagement.
projects.description:
**Introducing Test Ranking: Elevating E-Gaming Community Engagement**

Test Ranking is not just an app; it's a testament to the collaborative spirit of the Tesa association's e-gaming community in the Arab Maghreb Union. Created with passion and commitment, this mobile application, developed in Flutter for the front end and powered by NodeJS for the back end, serves as a dynamic hub for all things Tesa-related.


**Key Features:**

**1. Centralized Data Hub:**
Test Ranking consolidates Tesa association's vast array of information into one accessible platform. From news and events to tournaments, player biographies, rankings, and videos, users have a comprehensive view of the community's activities.

**2. Intuitive Data Navigation:**
Effortlessly explore Tesa's gaming universe with user-friendly features such as filtration by season (year), game type (global, regional, online), and game selection. Dive into the world of e-gaming with ease.

**3. Challonge API Integration:**
The app is on the verge of a revolutionary upgrade with the upcoming integration of the Challonge API. Admins will now have the power to create and manage tournaments seamlessly within the app, promoting centralization and streamlining the entire tournament process.

**4. Role-Based Access:**
Test Ranking recognizes the diversity of its community members with three distinct roles. Standard users can update their scores, admins enjoy comprehensive access and validation capabilities, while newsCreators contribute their skills in news creation.

**5. Enhanced User Engagement:**
Empowering players to update their scores directly within the app not only simplifies the process but also fosters increased user engagement. Admins can efficiently validate results, making the gaming experience more interactive and dynamic.

**6. Learning NodeJS and Flutter Integration:**
The development journey was a learning experience in itself. Venturing into NodeJS for the back end and seamlessly integrating it with Flutter provided not only a robust technical foundation but also expanded the skill set of the development team.

**7. Community Collaboration:**
Beyond the lines of code, Test Ranking thrives on community collaboration. Monthly meetings for updates and brainstorming sessions foster a sense of togetherness, making the project not just a technical achievement but a communal success.

**8. Volunteering at its Best:**
Test Ranking is a testimony to the power of volunteerism. It goes beyond being a mere application; it's a contribution to a thriving e-gaming community, driven by the collective passion and dedication of its creators.

Test Ranking is more than just a mobile app; it's a living, breathing entity that brings together the Tesa community. As the app continues to evolve, it stands as a beacon of innovation, collaboration, and the shared love for gaming within the Arab Maghreb Union.

projects.name: My Weekly Planner
projects.overview: My Weekly Planner is a comprehensive life organization app that simplifies task management and goal setting. Tailored for professionals, the app allows users to define and manage roles, plan their weekly schedule, and track daily progress. With features like role-based task organization, intuitive planning interfaces, and insightful statistics, this app empowers users to achieve their goals efficiently.
projects.description:
My Weekly Planner is more than just a task management app; it's a personalized life organizer designed to bring structure and efficiency to your daily routine.

**My Roles:**
The "My Roles" feature lets users categorize tasks based on predefined life roles, providing a unique perspective on priorities. From being a parent to a tech enthusiast, users can tailor roles to align with their diverse responsibilities.

**My Weekly Planner:**
The "My Weekly Planner" screen serves as the central hub for planning the upcoming week. Users can set daily priorities, add tasks manually or from the inbox, and navigate future weeks for seamless planning. The app's intuitive design ensures that users can stay focused on their weekly objectives effortlessly.

**My Day:**
In the "My Day" screen, users experience a focused view of their daily tasks, with highlighted priorities and a progress bar to motivate task completion. The ability to add, edit, and prioritize tasks, along with a quick glance at the next day's tasks, ensures flexibility and adaptability in daily planning.

**Settings:**
The "Settings" screen provides a range of customization options, from language preferences to theme choices, catering to users' individual tastes. Features such as backup/restore, data sync, and notification management contribute to a personalized and secure user experience.

**Statistics:**
Dive into insightful statistics with the "Statistics" screen, offering velocity charts, pie charts representing done tasks by role, and line charts tracking daily task commitments. These tools provide users with a visual representation of their progress, helping them stay motivated and committed to their goals.

In summary, My Weekly Planner goes beyond traditional task management, offering a holistic approach to life organization. With features for role-based task categorization, intuitive planning interfaces, customizable settings, and detailed statistics, this app is a valuable companion for anyone looking to enhance productivity and achieve their life goals.

projects.name: Randev
projects.overview: Randev is an innovative and user-friendly appointment management app designed to streamline scheduling for professionals and end consumers. Ideal for hairstylists, beauty salons, and driving lesson instructors, Randev simplifies the appointment process for businesses in these industries.
projects.description:
Randev redefines appointment management, providing a seamless solution for both professionals and consumers. Tailored for hairstylists, beauty salons, and driving lesson instructors, Randev offers a customizable profile creation feature for professionals. This includes detailed service listings, availability, and pricing, empowering consumers to browse profiles and find the perfect match for their needs.

**Online Booking:**
Facilitating direct appointment bookings through the app eliminates the need for phone calls or in-person interactions. The app boasts an intuitive calendar system, enabling professionals and consumers to effortlessly view and manage upcoming appointments from any device—be it a smartphone, tablet, or computer. The automatic synchronization of calendars prevents double bookings and ensures efficient appointment planning.

**Chat with Customers:**
Randev fosters easy communication between professionals and consumers through its built-in messaging feature. Both parties can exchange messages related to appointments, confirming details, asking questions, or making necessary adjustments. Professionals can also send reminders to clients before appointments, reducing no-shows and ensuring seamless scheduling. The reminder system can be configured for automatic client notifications.

**In App Payment:**
To streamline transactions, Randev incorporates a secure payment system that allows consumers to pay for appointments directly through the app. Whether using credit cards, debit cards, or PayPal, the app supports various payment methods. The integrated receipt system further simplifies accounting for both professionals and consumers.

In summary, Randev is an all-in-one appointment management solution that simplifies the scheduling process for both professionals and consumers. With its user-friendly and intuitive interface, the app ensures a seamless experience for all parties involved.

projects.name: PMC
projects.overview: I spearheaded the transformation of a .NET desktop app into a Flutter web-based Project Management Cockpit for a banking client. As Scrum Master and Front-end Developer, I led the team, managed Jira tickets, and created reusable widgets, implementing vital features. The migration involved overcoming challenges like integrating with a .NET back-end and adopting a grid system. The outcome is a streamlined, cloud-based solution that significantly enhances reporting transparency and decision-making efficiency for the client.
projects.description:
**Project Overview:**
		**Project Name:** PMC (Project Management Cockpit)
		**Duration:** November 2022 to December 2023

**Project Description:**
		**Objective:**
		Developed a web-based version of PMC for automated project reporting and management within banks.

		**Roles and Responsibilities:**
		**Scrum Master:**
		Led the Scrum team, organized and facilitated ceremonies.
		Prepared Jira tickets, managed sprint planning, and backlog.

		**Front-end Development:**
		Transformed a .NET desktop application into a Flutter web app.
		Created reusable widgets and implemented various features like cruds, analysis, and reporting.

		**Challenges:**
		Successfully migrated from a .NET desktop app to a Flutter web app.
		Collaborated with the back-end team handling a Restful API.
		Implemented a grid system (PlutoGrid package) based on the client's historical use of Excel.

		**Achievements:**
		Introduced a weekly knowledge-sharing meeting for Flutter developers.
		Improved reporting transparency and efficiency for project progress update with the client.

		**Client's Description:**
		Automated planning and control software, consolidating all necessary information.
		Features a web-based version (vPOS) that is cloud-based, easy to handle, transparent, and stable.
		Provides a stable overview of reporting KPIs and transparent budget allocation.

**Technologies Used:**
		**Front-end:**
		Flutter for web application development.

		**Back-end:**
	 .NET for Restful API.

**Results:**
		**Client Benefits:**
		Efficient reporting system.
		Quick decision-making based on up-to-date and accurate data.
		Stable overview of reporting KPIs and transparent budget allocation.

		**Upgrades:**
		PMC evolved from an Excel document to a .NET application and then to the current Flutter web application.

**Confidentiality Consideration:**
Due to confidentiality agreements, specific details about some features might not be disclosed.

projects.name: Cha9a9ti Plus
projects.overview: Cha9a9ti Plus is an innovative hybrid savings product that pairs a physical wooden savings box with a companion mobile application, designed to help individuals and couples build consistent saving habits in a tangible, rewarding way. The app tracks every coin deposited into the box, enables users to define saving goals with deadlines and motivational names, and supports shared partner vaults for couples working toward common financial targets. By combining the psychological satisfaction of physical saving with the data visibility of a digital tracker, Cha9a9ti Plus creates a unique and effective approach to personal finance discipline.
projects.description:
***A Hybrid Physical-Digital Savings Platform***

Cha9a9ti Plus reimagines traditional saving by pairing a real wooden savings box with a mobile application that brings transparency, accountability, and motivation to everyday financial discipline. Whether saving for a vacation, an emergency fund, or a personal milestone, users interact with a familiar physical object while a smart app tracks their every step.

***How It Works***

**1. Log Your Savings:** Every coin or bill deposited into the physical box is manually recorded in the app, keeping a precise digital tally of your growing savings.
**2. Set a Goal:** Define what you're saving for — a specific amount, a motivational name, and a target date — turning abstract savings into a concrete objective.
**3. Share the Journey:** Add a partner or family member to a shared vault, combining deposits and milestones for goals you're building together.
**4. Track Progress:** Visual charts and milestone celebrations keep motivation high throughout the saving journey.


***Key Features***

🐷 **Vault Tracking:** Precise ledger of every deposit with running totals and history.
🎯 **Goal Setting:** Named saving targets with amounts, deadlines, and progress indicators.
👫 **Partner Vaults:** Share a vault with another user for couple or family saving goals.
📊 **Progress Visualization:** Charts and milestones that celebrate saving achievements.
🔐 **Secure Authentication:** JWT-based auth with refresh tokens for data security.
📱 **Cross-device Sync:** All savings data synchronized across devices via a Node.js backend.


***Technical Architecture***

**Frontend:** Flutter mobile application using GetX for state management and reactive UI.
**Backend:** Node.js REST API built with Express.js for business logic and data persistence.
**Database:** PostgreSQL managed through Prisma ORM for type-safe, reliable queries.
**Auth:** JWT authentication with access and refresh token rotation for long-lived sessions.

Cha9a9ti Plus demonstrates the power of combining tangible, habit-forming physical products with the data visibility of modern mobile applications — a fintech concept designed around real human behavior.

projects.name: Artisan Affiliate Marketplace
projects.overview: Artisan Affiliate Marketplace is a multi-vendor e-commerce platform that bridges the gap between skilled artisan workshops and digital content creators, enabling artisans to grow their reach through an affiliate marketing model without a dedicated marketing team. Artisans onboard their products with custom commission structures, while influencers and content creators generate unique tracking links, promote products to their audiences, and earn commissions on every attributed sale. The platform automates the full affiliate lifecycle — from link generation and click tracking to commission calculation and payout processing via the Flouci payment gateway — delivering a transparent and scalable partnership model for Tunisian artisanal businesses.
projects.description:
***A Bridge Between Artisans and Influencers***

Artisan Affiliate Marketplace solves a core challenge for small artisan businesses: reaching new audiences without a marketing budget. By creating a structured affiliate program platform, artisans can onboard influencers who promote their handcrafted products in exchange for performance-based commissions — creating a win-win ecosystem built on results.

***For Artisans (Vendors)***

**Multi-vendor Storefronts:** Each artisan workshop gets its own branded storefront with product listings, images, pricing, and inventory management.
**Affiliate Program Configuration:** Define commission rates per product category or individual item, giving fine-grained control over profitability.
**Order & Revenue Management:** Track orders, shipment statuses, and cumulative revenue from affiliate-driven sales.
**Analytics Dashboard:** Sales performance, affiliate conversion rates, and earnings breakdowns at a glance.

***For Affiliates (Influencers)***

**Unique Tracking Links:** Generate personalized affiliate links for any product to attribute sales accurately.
**Real-time Commission Tracking:** Live view of clicks, conversions, and pending earnings.
**Payout Management:** Request withdrawals via the integrated Flouci payment orchestration gateway.
**Performance Analytics:** Detailed conversion data to optimize promotional strategies.

***Platform Administration***

**Vendor Onboarding:** Verify artisan accounts and review product listings before activation.
**Transaction Oversight:** Monitor all affiliate transactions and handle commission disputes.
**Content Moderation:** Manage product quality standards and affiliate link policies.


***Technical Architecture***

**Frontend:** Flutter Web with GetX state management and go_router for clean navigation.
**Backend:** Node.js + Express REST API with PostgreSQL for data persistence.
**Payments:** Flouci Payment Orchestration API for local Tunisian market payment processing.
**Storage:** S3-compatible object storage for product images and media.
**Deployment:** Docker containers orchestrated with Docker Compose, served behind a Caddy reverse proxy on an Ubuntu VPS.

projects.name: Campione
projects.overview: Campione is a comprehensive sports field booking platform targeting the Tunisian market, designed to become the go-to solution for sports complex discovery, real-time slot reservation, and online payments across Sfax and Tunis. The platform centralizes all sports complexes on a single marketplace, enabling players to browse fields by sport, view availability calendars, and book and pay online — eliminating the friction of phone reservations and walk-in bookings. Field owners gain a dedicated management dashboard for complex profiles, pricing configuration, and financial reporting, while the platform supports flexible commission models to accommodate diverse commercial agreements.
projects.description:
***Centralizing Sports Field Booking in Tunisia***

Campione addresses a fragmented sports booking market where most field reservations still happen via phone calls or walk-ins. By bringing all sports complexes onto one platform, Campione creates a seamless digital booking experience for players while equipping field owners with professional management tools.

***User Roles***

**Player (User)**
Browse nearby sports fields by sport type, price range, and availability. View field photos, descriptions, and slot pricing. Book and pay for time slots online. Track booking history and manage cancellations according to the field's policy.

**Field Owner (Admin)**
Create and manage complex profiles with images, descriptions, and multiple fields. Configure sport types, hourly pricing, and availability calendars. Manage incoming bookings and view financial reports. Create tournaments and manage registrations (Phase 2).

**System Admin (Platform)**
Onboard field owners following commercial agreements. Set commission structures and validate payouts. Access global analytics and resolve booking disputes.


***Key Platform Modules***

**1. Booking Engine (Critical):** Real-time slot locking for 2–3 minutes during checkout to prevent double bookings. Cancellation policy enforcement and refund processing logic.
**2. Flexible Payment Models:**
**Model A (Platform-Managed):** Player pays the platform → commission deducted automatically → remainder credited to owner wallet with withdrawal requests.
**Model B (Owner-Managed):** Player pays owner directly → platform tracks monthly commission → invoiced to owner at month end.
**3. Marketplace:** Geo-based field discovery with map and list view toggle. Filters by sport, price, and rating.
**4. Financial System:** Owner wallets, transaction histories, withdrawal requests, and commission ledgers.
**5. Push Notifications:** Booking confirmations, payment updates, and cancellation alerts sent in real time.


***Phase 2 — Tournament Engine***

Campione's roadmap includes a full tournament engine as a competitive differentiator — supporting League, Knockout, Group+Knockout, and Championship formats with customizable points systems, team registration fees, real-time fixtures, and leaderboards.


***Technical Architecture***

**Mobile App:** Flutter + GetX for the player-facing booking experience on Android and iOS.
**Web Dashboard:** Flutter Web for field owner management portal.
**Backend:** Node.js + Express REST API with PostgreSQL for the booking engine, wallet system, and commission tracking.
**Deployment:** Docker + Caddy reverse proxy on a production Ubuntu VPS.

projects.name: Vape Store
projects.overview: Vape Store is a full-stack e-commerce solution developed for a vape products retailer, comprising a customer-facing Flutter mobile application, a comprehensive admin dashboard, and a production-ready Node.js REST API with over 50 endpoints and 10 database tables. The platform supports the complete retail lifecycle — from product browsing and purchase transactions to pre-order management, promotional offers, and inventory tracking — all built on a clean, layered architecture designed for long-term maintainability. Role-based access control distinguishes between customers and administrators, giving the business full control over its catalog, orders, and analytics from a dedicated management interface.
projects.description:
***A Complete E-Commerce Solution for Vape Retail***

Vape Store provides everything a vape products retailer needs to operate digitally: a polished mobile shopping experience for customers, a powerful admin tool for business management, and a robust backend that ties it all together. Built with a production-first mindset, the platform handles complex retail operations while remaining straightforward to maintain and extend.

***Customer Mobile App***

**Product Catalog:** Browse all available products with multi-language support, category filtering, and detailed item pages.
**Favorites:** Save preferred products for quick future access.
**Purchase Flow:** Streamlined checkout with full transaction management and purchase history.
**Pre-orders:** Advance booking system for upcoming and out-of-stock products.
**Offers:** View active promotions and limited-time deals.

***Admin Dashboard***

**Analytics Dashboard:** Sales KPIs, revenue trends, and business performance insights in one view.
**Product Management:** Full CRUD for products and categories with multi-language description support.
**Inventory Control:** Stock movement audit trail for accurate inventory tracking.
**Order Processing:** Manage purchases and pre-orders with quick scan support for rapid fulfillment.
**App Settings:** Dynamic configuration management without requiring app updates.

***Backend API (Node.js)***

**Architecture:** Clean 5-layer design — Routes → Controllers → Services → Models → Database.
**50+ Endpoints:** Comprehensive API covering authentication, products, users, purchases, pre-orders, offers, analytics, and settings.
**10 Database Tables:** Users, products, purchases, purchase_items, preorders, preorder_items, favorites, offers, stock_movements, and settings.
**Security:** JWT authentication, bcrypt password hashing (10 rounds), role-based access control, and SQL injection prevention via parameterized queries.
**Deployment:** Docker + Docker Compose for consistent, reproducible deployment.


***Technical Architecture***

**Frontend (Customer):** Flutter + GetX mobile application for Android and iOS.
**Admin Dashboard:** Dedicated Flutter + GetX web interface for business management.
**Backend:** Node.js + Express with PostgreSQL and a modular service-layer architecture.
**Infrastructure:** Docker Compose for local and production deployment.

projects.name: IIT Grades Leaderboard
projects.overview: IIT Grades Leaderboard is a Flutter web application built for the Higher Institute of Technology (IIT) student community, centralizing academic grades across all subjects and generating a real-time, ranked leaderboard for student groups. The platform allows students to view their standing relative to peers, track performance across modules, and foster healthy academic competition in a transparent and accessible format. Built with Firebase for secure authentication and real-time data synchronization, the application ensures grades are always up to date and securely attributed to the correct student accounts.
projects.description:
***Transparent Academic Rankings for IIT Students***

IIT Grades Leaderboard was built to address the lack of a centralized grade tracking system for students at the Higher Institute of Technology. Rather than relying on scattered grade sheets and manual comparisons, the platform aggregates all subject grades, calculates cumulative averages, and presents the entire group's standings in a clean, sortable leaderboard.

***Key Features***

**🏅 Live Rankings:** Real-time leaderboard sorted by cumulative GPA, updating instantly as grades are entered.
**📚 Multi-subject Tracking:** Grade input and storage for all enrolled subjects with weighted average calculation.
**🔐 Secure Access:** Firebase Authentication ensures each student can only view or modify their own grade submissions.
**🔒 Encrypted Local Storage:** Sensitive session data is protected using encrypted shared preferences.
**☁️ Cloud Sync:** All grades and rankings synchronized via Cloud Firestore for real-time multi-device access.
**📱 Responsive Design:** Accessible from both web browsers and mobile devices without a native app install.


***Technical Architecture***

**App:** Flutter Web deployed as a web application accessible from any browser.
**Backend:** Firebase suite — Firestore for data storage, Firebase Auth for user management, and Firebase Storage for assets.
**State Management:** GetX for reactive UI updates and clean controller separation.
**Security:** encrypted_shared_preferences for sensitive local data protection.

projects.name: Quiz Kids Arena
projects.overview: Quiz Kids Arena is a browser-based interactive quiz platform designed for educational settings, enabling instructors to manage quiz content while students participate in engaging, timed quiz sessions from any device. The platform features a dual-mode interface — an admin panel for instructors to configure questions, sections, and time limits, and a student-facing quiz experience with countdown timers, live score updates, and detailed result summaries. Built entirely with vanilla JavaScript and HTML/CSS, Quiz Kids Arena requires no installation or backend infrastructure, making it immediately deployable in classrooms and study groups with a simple browser link.
projects.description:
***An Accessible Quiz Platform for Educators and Students***

Quiz Kids Arena was designed around a simple premise: every classroom should have access to interactive quizzes without needing complex software or technical setup. By running entirely in the browser with no backend dependency, instructors can deploy a fully functional quiz experience with just a file — and students can join from any device with a web browser.

***Student Experience***

**Engaging Quiz Flow:** Clean, distraction-free interface presenting one question at a time with clear answer options.
**Timed Questions:** Each question has a configurable countdown timer, adding challenge and energy to quiz sessions.
**Live Score Updates:** Students see their running score update after each question, keeping engagement high.
**Detailed Results:** End-of-quiz summary showing final score, correct answers, and a breakdown of performance.

***Instructor (Admin) Mode***

**Quiz Configuration:** Add, edit, and reorder questions with customizable answer options and correct answer selection.
**Section Management:** Organize questions into topic-based sections (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for structured quizzes.
**Time Limit Control:** Set individual time limits per question for fine-grained pacing control.
**Live Session Control:** Start and manage quiz sessions for live classroom use.


***Technical Design***

**Vanilla JavaScript:** No frameworks or build tools — pure DOM manipulation for maximum portability and zero dependencies.
**JSON-driven Content:** Quiz content is defined in a simple structured quiz.json file, making it easy for non-developers to update questions.
**HTML5 / CSS3:** Responsive, mobile-friendly design with FontAwesome icons for a polished user interface.
**Zero Infrastructure:** Runs entirely client-side — no server, no database, no deployment pipeline required.
